_comment: preview.coo.ee's TRUSTED PRODUCERS — deployment config for one specific box, NOT image content. Kept out of deploy/image/trust/ deliberately: baking these made every adopter of the prebuilt image inherit trust in nine repos, which on a box with SERVE_ALLOW_RENDER_TRUSTED=1 is eligibility for server-side execution of those repos' Compose. This copy now serves deploy/vps, which bind-mounts it; the prebuilt-image profile that used to default to it moved to yschimke/compose-preview-server, and that repository owns preview.coo.ee's live config and publishes it. Edit it THERE for a change that must reach the box; a change here reaches nothing on its own. Both paths use .github/scripts/publish-config-to-box.sh via POST /admin/trust. Must cover every catalog in catalogs.json beside this file, or that catalog serves as `unverified`.
